message.content:
The pattern is integer halving (rounding down/flooring):  
\(-8 \to -4 \to -2 \to -1\), and once you reach \(-1\), half of \(-1\) floors to \(-1\) again.

So the next term is \(-1\).

<answer>-1</answer>
